exposure: myoma characteristics (size, position, number of fibroids removed)
cohort: Patients who underwent Robotic-assisted laparoscopic myomectomy (RALM) for fertility enhancement between August 2012 and May 2023.
finding: Robotic-assisted laparoscopic myomectomy (RALM) was found to be an effective method for fertility enhancement, achieving an 86.04% pregnancy rate and a 73.25% live birth rate among analyzed patients, with no statistical difference regarding fibroid number or size with pregnancy outcome.
mod_finding: All 63 live births in the study were delivered by cesarean section.
